verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs show you can take repository contents out in open formats: download a zip snapshot or clone the full git history, including via `gh repo clone`. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party export of everything else (issues, PRs, discussions, wikis, account data) in open formats. The REST/GraphQL APIs are only building blocks for that, and the community git-bug suggestion is a user workaround, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: documented full account/organization data export (issues, PRs, discussions, settings), open-format archive of non-code data, migration-out tooling, independent corroboration of a complete exit path.
